blocking_findings.title: Final out_fire and newly accepted invalid old-task event can publish success before the event retires
blocking_findings.evidence_kind: Static confirmation of root-reported candidate; root owns actual RTL reproduction
blocking_findings.trigger: With q_valid empty, normal final out_valid/out_last/out_ready and in_valid/op7/oldtask asserted on the same edge, input ready remains high. That edge enqueues q and DRAIN sets core_done. Illegal event fault is only evaluated one clock later.
blocking_findings.coverage_gap: Existing fault_on_fire/fault_preserves_block act at the first valid64-result block of M5N32, compare only64of160 outputs. op13 waits only out_valid; there is no final-output simultaneous command test. early-done TB assertion checks output count/fault, not unresolved accepted event.
